description: PPT design skills as an installable agent plugin.

plugins.name: ppt-design-skills
plugins.description: A general-purpose PPT / deck design methodology: logic layer (Pyramid Principle, MECE, SCQA), visual layer (Gestalt, rule of thirds, Hick's law, CRAP), structure layer (5W2H, SWOT, funnel, timeline), numeric specs, wall-of-text handling, and pluggable colour themes.
